quotes.text: Review and complete its leaves; do not widen scope. Plan only; run no test suite

fields.summary: Autonomous plan run, no owner. The orchestrator's message said: review and complete the leaves drafted from milestone 38 (PR #583), do not widen scope, plan only and run no test suite, decide with wording '(assumed, would have escalated)'. Research: go.mod pins github.com/mattn/go-runewidth v0.0.27 (indirect, via charmbracelet/colorprofile and charmbracelet/x/ansi); its init() merges the interval tables, builds eastAsianWidth and the full strict LUT eagerly. The proxy lists v0.0.28 to v0.0.31; v0.0.28 and later init only the first 0x300 LUT entries and build the rest lazily (sync.Once), and v0.0.31's go.mod requires the same github.com/clipperhouse/uax29/v2 v2.2.0 as v0.0.27, so the bump adds no dependency. Only internal/tui/inboxapp imports ansi directly; internal/web uses no width code. internal/slice TestFit sweeps every budget from uncut down to 1 in 'cuts in order' (markdown and JSON) and linearly in 'footer'; fit() also checks the byte rules at each budget; TestFitWithin's comment says TestFit's sweeps check fit-within for big, which goes stale once the sweep goes.
fields.title: Plan review of Cheap start, boundary TestFit (autonomous)
